name: Waffle
summary: Golden waffle with grid pockets, a butter pat and syrup running down, for breakfast and brunch scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the waffle rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~400 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: shape
params.note: square Belgian-style or round stovetop waffle

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
